criteria: Given a repository where .adlc/manifest.d exists with segment files and .adlc/manifest.jsonl does not exist, when the Claude Code Stop hook runs manifest(), then it invokes gate-manifest verify --json --allow-legacy-unsigned instead of returning early.
Given a repository where neither .adlc/manifest.jsonl nor .adlc/manifest.d exists, when the Claude Code Stop hook runs manifest(), then it returns early without invoking gate-manifest.
intent: Resolve #803: plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs manifest() returns early if .adlc/manifest.jsonl does not exist, skipping Stop-hook manifest verification in forest-mode repos whose evidence lives only in .adlc/manifest.d/*.jsonl. Check for either .adlc/manifest.jsonl or .adlc/manifest.d before returning early.
title: fix(adlc-claude-code): run Stop-hook manifest verification when .adlc/manifest.d exists without root manifest.jsonl
